tei:titleStmt.tei:title: For Monday and Thursday: There is none like You, gracious and merciful Adonoy, our Go

tei:availability.tei:p: Published by Sefaria under CC-BY, which Sefaria defines as Creative Commons Attribution 3.0.

tei:div.tei:p: There is none like You, gracious and merciful Adonoy, our God; there is none like You, Almighty, slow to anger, abundant in kindliness and truth. Deliver us with Your great mercy, save us from storm and rage. Remember Your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; do not consider our stubbornness, our wickedness and our sinfulness. Turn from Your fierce anger and let Your mind be changed concerning the evil [intended] for Your people. Remove from us the scourge of death, for You are merciful; for such is Your way— to bestow undeserved kindness in every generation. Spare Your people, Adonoy, and save us from Your wrath; remove from us the scourge of plague, and harsh decree, for You are the Guardian of Israel. Righteousness is Yours, my Master, while shame is ours. How can we complain? What can we say? What can we speak? and how can we justify ourselves? Let us search into our ways and examine them, and return to You; for Your right hand is extended to receive those who repent. We beseech You Adonoy!—deliver us. We beseech You Adonoy!—grant us success; We beseech You Adonoy! — answer us on the day we call. For You, Adonoy, we have waited, For You, Adonoy, we have hoped, For You, Adonoy, we yearn. Do not be silent, and do not allow us to be tormented; for the nations have said, “Their hope is lost.” Let every knee and all who stand erect prostrate themselves only before You.
